520	His grandson is Moshe Rabbeinu.	O neto dela é Moshé Rabeinu.
521	His grandson is the Rambam.	O neto dela é o Rambam.
522	For such grandchildren you need seventy years of preparation beforehand.	Para netos assim, são necessários setenta anos de preparação antes.
523	So therefore: "And HaShem remembered Sarah as He had said, and HaShem did to Sarah as	Por isso: "E HaShem se lembrou de Sara como havia dito, e HaShem fez a Sara como
524	He had spoken."	havia falado."
525	"And Sarah conceived and bore a son to Avraham	"E Sara concebeu e deu a Avraham um filho
526	in his old age, at the appointed time	na sua velhice, no tempo determinado
527	of which Elokim had spoken to him." Rabbi Yehuda and Rabbi Nechemia. Rashi: Rabbi Yehuda says this teaches that he was born after nine	de que Elokim lhe havia falado." Rabi Yehudá e Rabi Nechemiá. Rashi: Rabi Yehudá diz que isso ensina que ele nasceu após nove
528	months, so that they would not say, "from Avimelech's house." And Rabbi Nechemia	meses, para que não dissessem: "da casa de Avimelech." E Rabi Nechemiá
529	says: after seven months.	diz: após sete meses.
530	"In his old age" — because his features resembled his. "At the appointed time"	"Na sua velhice", porque as feições dele eram parecidas com as dele. "No tempo determinado"
531	"of which He had spoken to him" — He had fixed the appointed time of which He spoke,	"de que lhe havia falado": Ele havia fixado o tempo de que falou,
532	and He set it. When He said to him, "At the appointed time I will return to you," Avraham scratched a mark	e o estabeleceu. Quando disse: "No tempo determinado voltarei a ti", Avraham fez um risco
533	on the wall and told her: when the sun reaches this mark next year, you will give birth.	na parede e disse-lhe: quando o sol chegar a este risco, no ano seguinte, darás à luz.
534	That is the appointed time. "And Avraham called the name of his son who was born	Esse é o tempo determinado. "E Avraham deu ao seu filho, que nasceu
535	to him, whom Sarah bore to him, Yitzchak." "And Avraham circumcised	a ele, que Sara lhe deu, o nome de Yitschak." "E Avraham circuncidou
536	Yitzchak his son when he was eight days old,	Yitschak, seu filho, quando tinha oito dias,
537	as Elokim had commanded him." And Avraham circumcised Yitzchak his son at eight days old, as	como Elokim lhe havia ordenado." E Avraham circuncidou Yitschak, seu filho, aos oito dias, como
538	Adonai had commanded him. "And Avraham was a hundred	Adonai lhe havia ordenado. "E Avraham tinha cem
539	years old when Yitzchak his son was born to him." And Avraham was a hundred years old when	anos quando Yitschak, seu filho, nasceu para ele." E Avraham tinha cem anos quando
540	Yitzchak his son was born to him. "And Sarah said, laughter	Yitschak, seu filho, nasceu para ele. "E Sara disse: riso
541	Elokim has made for me; everyone who hears will laugh for me."	Elokim fez para mim; todo aquele que ouvir rirá por mim."
542	And Sarah said: Adonai has made joy for me; everyone who hears will rejoice for me.	E Sara disse: Adonai fez alegria para mim; todo aquele que ouvir se alegrará por mim.
543	Rashi: "Will laugh for me" — will rejoice over me.	Rashi: "Rirá por mim", isto é, se alegrará por mim.
544	And the Midrash Aggadah: many barren women were remembered with her, many sick were healed	E o Midrash Agadá: muitas estéreis foram lembradas com ela, muitos doentes foram curados
545	on that day, many prayers were answered with her, and there was much laughter in the world.	naquele dia, muitas preces foram atendidas com ela, e houve muito riso no mundo.
546	There was much joy.	Houve muita alegria.
547	Yes.	Sim.
548	Gentlemen,	Senhores,
549	two things.	duas coisas.
550	One: it is written in Parashat Toldot that HaShem made the face of	Primeira: está escrito na Parashat Toldot que HaShem fez o rosto de
551	Yitzchak Avinu look like Avraham's, two drops of water, so that they would not say Sarah conceived from Avimelech.	Yitschak Avinu parecido com o de Avraham, duas gotas de água, para que não dissessem que Sara concebeu de Avimelech.
552	So naturally, at first everyone said, ah, a foundling from the marketplace.	Então, naturalmente, no início todos diziam: ah, um enjeitado da feira.
553	Afterward they saw that Sarah nursed children.	Depois viram que Sara amamentava filhos.
554	So naturally, enough, you can't say foundling.	Então, naturalmente, chega, não se pode dizer enjeitado.
555	So they said, fine, but she conceived from Avimelech, so now the Holy One, blessed be He, made Yitzchak's face look	Então disseram: bem, mas ela concebeu de Avimelech; então agora o Santo, bendito seja Ele, fez o rosto de Yitschak parecido
556	like Avraham's, two drops of water. So now what will they say?	com o de Avraham, duas gotas de água. E agora, o que vão dizer?
557	They have nothing to say. But that is only for whoever saw Yitzchak and Avraham. But	Não têm o que dizer. Mas isso vale só para quem viu Yitschak e Avraham. Mas
558	"everyone who hears will laugh for me" — he can still go on	"todo aquele que ouvir rirá por mim": ele ainda pode continuar
